question: What BLEU score did the Transformer (big) model achieve on WMT 2014 English-to-German?
reason: The BLEU score achieved by the Transformer (big) model on WMT 2014 English-to-German is detailed in the 'Attention Is All You Need' paper.
search_query: BLEU score Transformer big model WMT 2014 English-German site:arxiv.org
answer:
The Transformer (big) model achieved a BLEU score of 28.4 on the WMT 2014 English-to-German translation task. This score establishes a new state-of-the-art, outperforming the best previously reported models by more than 2.0 BLEU points. The training for this model took 3.5 days on 8 P100 GPUs, and even the base model surpassed all previously published models and ensembles at a fraction of the training cost of any competitive models (source: "Attention Is All You Need," Section 6.1 Machine Translation).

Sources: "Attention Is All You Need," Section 6.1 Machine Translation.

answer:
The Transformer architecture encodes the position of words using positional encodings, which are added to the input embeddings. This method allows the model to incorporate information about the position of each word in the sequence, despite the absence of recurrence. The positional encodings are generated using sine and cosine functions of different frequencies, enabling the model to learn the relative positions of words effectively. This approach allows the Transformer to maintain the order of words while leveraging its parallel processing capabilities.
